calls with customers, WhatsApp sign-up and Business app coexistence, noise removal on the agent's microphone, industry agent desktops, setup snapshots, and new campaign, sales and ticket reports.

Video calls: a website visitor can start a video call from the chat widget and the agent answers in a video window on the desk, with the back camera, screen sharing and Take a picture for remote visual help. Video is only used where the widget allows it; every other call stays audio only.

Noise removal for agents: background noise (voices, keyboards, a dog) is taken out of the agent's microphone before the customer hears it; switch it on in Settings, agents can turn it off for themselves.

WhatsApp: connect a number with Connect with WhatsApp on Messaging instead of pasting ids, keep using the WhatsApp Business app on the same number (messages sent from the app appear in the conversation), and view and edit a number's business profile on its account form.

Industry agent desktops: choose which tabs the agent desk shows, in what order and which opens first, or start from a ready layout for your industry (Settings).

Setup snapshots: keep a copy of a tenant's setup, compare it with now, roll back, or promote it from a test tenant to the live one.

Websites as knowledge: add your website as a knowledge base source, swept daily, with suggested official sites for your industry.

AI agent tests: voice tests for AI agents, with what was said beside what was heard, a nightly run, and failed nightly runs shown in the AI monitor.

Workforce: the intraday rule can now move agents' breaks (by up to the minutes you set, once each) when the next hour is short-staffed; agents are told, and planners see what moved.

Freshdesk callers now show on the agent's customer card with their open tickets; editing a people plan no longer resets its queues, shrinkage and occupancy.

Script forms: a form can be limited to signed-in users of your organisation, and each response shows who filled it in. Plus autosave, picture upload, phone fields, answer rules, named endings, a progress bar and version history, with responses filterable by version and ending.

A refreshed look, finished: the quieter menu and wider pages reach the desk, the reseller and platform tables, and the Get the apps page.

Reports: outbound calls by 5 and 10 minute interval (unique numbers, sales, rates, agent wait); first contact resolution (24 hours) per campaign; leads by attempts so far in List performance; hangup causes by campaign with an hour-of-day heat map; minutes and cost per campaign and international calls by carrier (carrier cost is shown to platform billing operators only); tickets with SLA breached count and percentage, grouped by channel.

Real-time and sales: set a daily sales target per campaign and see the run rate and forecast on Real-time and wallboards; Real-time also shows each campaign's dial speed settings and live figures. Number Manager shows risk bands, silent answers, a rest countdown and a repeat-dial check.

Fixes: a ticket's owner keeps the customer's reply whatever skills the queue needs.

Install: this release changes the FreeSWITCH dialplan (infrastructure/freeswitch/conf/dialplan/uceo.xml, for video calls) and the Caddyfile content security policy (adds wasm-unsafe-eval on the agent desk, /agent/*, for noise removal); both ship with the release and need the new web and Caddy images. Seven database migrations: 8930 and 8940 script forms, 8950 desk layout, 8960 noise removal, 9010 dial attempts index, 9020 setup snapshots, 9030 AI agent voice tests."}
